simple.meaning: פֶּשַׁע (peshaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a revolt (national, moral or religious).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 93 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Joshua, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 31:36. Its contexts include family, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פֶּשַׁע (H6588).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
